'''Bertoli''' is a male NPC found by the lighthouse of Helm Village, [[Riccioli Islands]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Bertoli:''' Ah... I know you! Heard about you from Mr. Fulmine some time ago.
:'''Bertoli:''' Didn't think I'd find you out here in the Riccioli Islands, though. Came for a bit of a break?
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' I'm here to become a fishing expert.
:'''{{DIcon}}:''' Just here for a vacation.
:'''Bertoli:''' This place is perfect for that, I'll give you that.
:'''Bertoli:''' You must've run into my colleague, [[Clemont]], then? He's been wandering the islands digging into the local history.
:'''Bertoli:''' There are secrets buried here, ones even the ruins of Ragunna City have no record of. Secrets about the Sentinel and that [[Cetus the Tidebreaker]]...
:'''Bertoli:''' Those lighthouses are the key to unlocking them, no doubt. Shame, though, the fishermen won't take us to the other two islands.
:'''Bertoli:''' There's a legend... Say, ever seen Cetus the Tidebreaker? The creature has three gem-like holes on its back.
:'''Bertoli:''' They say it wasn't always like that. No, it was a crew of sailors chasing it down who left those three marks on it hide.
:'''Bertoli:''' Can you imagine... what kind of men would have the strength to leave such scars on a creature like that?
{{Dialogue End}}
